description: Crawl an Amazon Brand Store (/stores/{Brand}/page/{ID}) - navigation, creative modules, and every validated product link on the page(s). Provide storeUrls directly, or productUrls/asins to auto-resolve the brand's store link from the product page.

asins.description: Product ASINs on amazon.com. Same resolution behavior as productUrls.
asins.title: ASINs (resolve brand store, amazon.com)

crawlSubpages.description: Follow the store's navigation menu (HOME, FEATURED DEALS, SSD, ...) and crawl every linked subpage, not just the landing page.
crawlSubpages.title: Crawl subpages

includeAssets.description: Also emit module/creative-asset records (images, video, CTA text, shoppable-image hotspots) found on each store page, not just product records.
includeAssets.title: Include creative assets

maxDepth.description: How many navigation-link hops to follow from the landing page when crawlSubpages is enabled (1 = landing page's direct subpages only).
maxDepth.title: Max navigation depth

maxPages.description: Hard cap on the total number of store pages (landing + subpages) fetched per store.
maxPages.title: Max store pages to fetch

maxProducts.description: Hard cap on the number of distinct product (ASIN) records emitted per store.
maxProducts.title: Max products per store

productUrls.description: Amazon product (/dp/{ASIN}) URLs. The actor visits each product page, finds its "Visit the {Brand} Store" link, and crawls that store instead.
productUrls.title: Product URLs (resolve brand store)

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. AUTO (datacenter) is used by default with homepage-priming; the actor escalates to RESIDENTIAL automatically only if it keeps getting blocked.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

storeUrls.description: Amazon Brand Store URLs, e.g. `https://www.amazon.com/stores/soundcore/page/AD6AD8C0-90C7-4C65-8000-0AC741FA2633`. At least one of storeUrls / productUrls / asins is required.
storeUrls.title: Brand Store URLs

title: Amazon Brand Store Scraper Input
